name.ja: ピカちんキットS06 ピカちんドローン

series.ja: ポチっと発明ピカちんキット

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: • ２つの「スゴイ」を携え、ピカちんキットがついにドローンをピラめいた！
description.en: • With two amazing features, Pikachin Kit finally hit the drone!

description.ja: • ピカちんドローンのここがスゴイ！その１「初心者でも簡単！」な機能が満載！
description.en: • What's amazing about the Pikachin drone! Part 1: Packed with features that are easy even for beginners!

description.ja: • ピカちんドローンのここがスゴイ！その２「ピカちんアタッチメント」でカスタマイズ！
description.en: • What's amazing about the Pikachin drone! Part 2: Customize with "Pikachin Attachment"!

description.ja: • 初めてでも飛ばせるRC（ラジオコントロール）ドローン！
description.en: • RC (radio control) drone that even first-timers can fly!

description.ja: • 気圧センサー搭載で高度を自動調整。ボタン１プッシュでカンタン離陸、片手で操作可能！
description.en: • Equipped with a barometric pressure sensor to automatically adjust altitude. Easy takeoff with one push of a button, can be operated with one hand!

description.ja: • 低・中・高の３段階から腕前に合わせて速度を選べる！
description.en: • You can choose the speed according to your skill from 3 levels: low, medium, and high!

description.ja: • アタッチメントは５種類！キミだけのピカちんドローンを作ろう！
description.en: • 5 types of attachments! Let's make your own Pikachin drone!

description.ja: • キャプテン★プロポンの表情シールが２種類付属。
description.en: • Captain★Two types of propon facial expressions are included.

description.ja: • 本体は組み立て済み！外装を取り付けてすぐに遊べる！
description.en: • The main body has been assembled! Attach the exterior and start playing right away!

description.ja: • スキルアップペーパークラフトが付属！フラッグ間を通したり、S字に旋回させたりしてスキルアップを目指せ！
description.en: • Skill-up paper craft included! Aim to improve your skills by passing between flags or turning in an S shape!
